correctness.rationale: Every maximal product cell is oriented by the parity of the increasing ordered partition (A,B,w); both ridge types have exactly two fillings with opposite signed incidences. The 2026 theorem independently supplies closed-connected-manifold structure. The first-coordinate graph-of-spaces has vertex and edge spaces with complete two-skeleta, hence simply connected for q>=2, and van Kampen gives free rank binomial(q+3,2). For q=2 the resulting closed orientable three-manifold with free pi1 rank ten is a tenfold connected sum S1xS2 by prime decomposition and Poincare. A fresh standalone enumeration tests ridge cancellation for all 1<=p,q<=5 and checks exact cellular mod-2/mod-3 boundary ranks for p=1,q=2. The all-size proof does not rely on extrapolating those tests.
